 import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

input_path = r"C:/Users/darpa/Downloads/Resume_Projects/AI Data Agent/data/etl_eval/output/h02/weather_multi_mar2025.parquet"
output_dir = r"C:/Users/darpa/Downloads/Resume_Projects/AI Data Agent/data/etl_eval/output/h02"

os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

df = pd.read_parquet(input_path)

def map_city(lat, lon):
    lat_r = round(lat, 2)
    lon_r = round(lon, 2)
    if lat_r == 49.28 and lon_r == -123.12:
        return "Vancouver"
    elif lat_r == 51.05 and lon_r == -114.07:
        return "Calgary"
    elif lat_r == 44.65 and lon_r == -63.57:
        return "Halifax"
    else:
        return np.nan

lat_col = None

for col in df.columns:
    if col.lower() in ["latitude", "lat"]:
        lat_col = col
    if col.lower() in ["longitude", "lon", "long"]:
        lon_col = col

df["city"] = df.apply(lambda row: map_city(row[lat_col], row[lon_col]), axis=1)

df["time"] = pd.to_datetime(df["time"]).dt.date

df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["city", "time"], keep="first")

drop_cols = [c for c in [lat_col, lon_col] if c is not None]
df = df.drop(columns=drop_cols)

df.to_parquet(output_path, index=False)

 import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import re

input_path = r"C:/Users/darpa/Downloads/Resume_Projects/AI Data Agent/data/etl_eval/input/payments_messy.csv"
output_dir = r"C:/Users/darpa/Downloads/Resume_Projects/AI Data Agent/data/etl_eval/output/h06"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

def clean_amount(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return np.nan
    s = str(val)
    s = re.sub(r'[A-Za-z$]', '', s)
    s = s.replace(',', '').strip()
    try:
        return float(s)
    except ValueError:
        return np.nan

df['amount_cad'] = df['amount'].apply(clean_amount)

def clean_date(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return np.nan
    s = str(val).strip()
    if '/' in s:
        dt = pd.to_datetime(s, format='%m/%d/%Y', errors='coerce')
    else:
        dt = pd.to_datetime(s, errors='coerce')
    if pd.isna(dt):
        return np.nan
    return dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')

df['paid_on'] = df['paid_on'].apply(clean_date)

df = df.drop(columns=['amount'])

output_path = os.path.join(output_dir, "payments_cleaned.parquet")
df.to_parquet(output_path, index=False)
